question.scenario: You work as a front desk associate at a hotel. While doing the shift handoff checklist, you notice a step that your team repeats every day and that adds about ten minutes without improving the result. You have an idea for a simpler way. Changing the shift handoff checklist is up to your front office supervisor.

options.text: Tell coworkers how pointless the step is, and hope the comment eventually reaches someone who is able to change it.
Start using your simpler method tomorrow without telling anyone, and see whether results improve.
Describe the extra step and your simpler idea to your front office supervisor, with an example of the time it costs.
Wait for the next scheduled improvement project, since fixing processes is not your job.
